arguments.summary: Technical setup is constructive over the 21- and 63-session mandate but less convincing over 5 sessions. Through the completed 2026-10-02 SIP session, ANET was above rising 20-, 50-, and 200-session averages, had positive absolute returns at 5/21/63 sessions, and led SPY at all three windows. Against XLK, however, it lagged over 5 sessions while leading over 21 and 63, so price-level strength and longer-window leadership coexist with near-term sector-relative cooling. A close just above the prior 21-session high occurred on below-median recent volume, while the 63-session path included a 15.5060% maximum close drawdown and materially higher realized volatility than SPY or XLK. Historical regime-conditioned forward-return frequencies were positive more often than not but below ANET's unconditional base rates at every horizon; they are dependent historical samples, not forecast probabilities. The IEX snapshot was a stale, single-venue market-closed observation and is not an executable consolidated quote.

claims.text: Completed-session setup: ANET closed at $207.35 on 2026-10-02 on the SIP, split-adjusted price-return basis. Its returns were +0.3873%, +11.4186%, and +19.6618% over 5, 21, and 63 sessions. The close was above SMA20 ($199.845), SMA50 ($193.4168), and SMA200 ($158.918), while annualized realized volatility was 15.6171%, 36.3858%, and 49.9571% over those same windows. This is absolute price strength with meaningful observed path variability, not an intrinsic-value signal or forecast.

PAIR ANET/SPY 5=+0.6090 21=+10.8331 63=+17.2180
PAIR ANET/XLK 5=-1.4163 21=+2.5896 63=+10.8151
These are matched-date, matched-feed, split-adjusted price-return excess returns in percentage points through 2026-10-02. ANET led SPY at each window, but versus XLK it shifted from a 5-session lag to 21- and 63-session leadership; therefore the recent rebound/strong price level does not establish near-term sector leadership.

The path panel shows ANET's SMA20 rose 1.6619% over five sessions and the close finished 0.3873% above the prior 21-session closing high. Participation was not strong: last-session volume was 0.9196 times the prior 20-session median and five-session average volume was 0.9579 times that median. The 63-session close path nonetheless experienced a -15.5060% maximum drawdown. Thus the level test and rising average support continuation, but one marginal high on sub-median volume is not sustained-breakout confirmation and the recovered endpoint obscures substantial interim drawdown.

Continuation case: holding above the frozen $199.845 SMA20 reference while maintaining positive 21- and 63-session excess returns versus XLK would support interpreting the current move as an intact medium-term trend with sector leadership. Opposing path: a completed close below that level, especially alongside a reversal of 21-session XLK excess return from positive to negative, would indicate that the high-RSI rebound is losing both absolute trend support and relative leadership. The present 5-session XLK lag is an early caution, not by itself a reversal of the 63-session setup.

In the coarse current regime (close above SMA20, SMA20 above SMA50, positive 21-session return), historical overlapping ANET observations had positive forward-return frequencies of 54.5741% over 5 sessions, 63.0915% over 21, and 65.2997% over 63 (317 observations each). Unconditional frequencies were higher at 58.4639%, 68.1818%, and 75.3918% (638 observations each). Conditional median returns were +0.3709%, +2.7508%, and +10.3247%, but conditional p10 outcomes were -7.5965%, -12.6617%, and -20.9394%. These dependent, overlapping observations from one finite 2023-12-15 to 2026-07-06 lookback are empirical context only—not calibrated probabilities, causal estimates, or guarantees—and do not show that the current momentum regime improved odds versus the unconditional history.

At assessment time the market was closed. The latest IEX-only trade was $207.335 at 2026-10-02 19:59:55 UTC and the displayed IEX quote at 20:00:00 UTC was $197.60 bid/$216.14 ask. This stale single-venue observation does not establish a current consolidated or executable quote; the qualified market reference is the completed SIP close of $207.35 dated 2026-10-02.

assumptions: All comparisons use the supplied 2026-10-02 completed session, SIP feed, split-adjusted prices, and price returns; distributions are excluded.
The $199.845 review level is the frozen SMA20 reported for 2026-10-02, not a future dynamically recomputed moving average and not an order level.

For the relative-leadership checkpoint, 'sustained' means two consecutive completed sessions on which recomputed matched 21-session ANET-minus-XLK excess return is negative; this is an analytical rule, not an empirically optimized trading signal.
arguments.counter_thesis: The constructive 63-session interpretation may be a late-stage rebound rather than durable leadership: RSI14 was 81.4148, the latest close was only 0.3873% above the prior 21-session closing high, recent volume remained below its prior median, and ANET already lagged XLK by 1.4163 percentage points over five sessions. A loss of the frozen SMA20 level combined with a sustained negative 21-session XLK-relative return would outweigh the current longer-window strength; conversely, continued positive 21/63-session sector excess and firmer participation would weaken this counter-case.

review_conditions.description: Research checkpoint: if ANET records a split-adjusted completed close below the frozen 2026-10-02 SMA20 level of $199.845 by 2026-11-02, treat the current rising-average/above-breakout setup as weakened and re-evaluate the continuation case; this is not a live or executable order threshold.

Recompute matched SIP, split-adjusted 21-session ANET-minus-XLK price-return excess after each completed session. Two consecutive negative readings would confirm that the present 5-session sector lag has spread into the medium window and weaken the 63-session leadership thesis; continued positive 21- and 63-session readings, preferably with recent five-session average volume above the preceding 20-session median, would support continuation.

agent_report.work_summary: I evaluated ANET's completed-session absolute returns, moving-average position, realized volatility, exact matched-window excess returns versus SPY and XLK, OHLCV-derived trend/high/volume/drawdown measures, historical regime-conditioned forward-return frequencies, and the distinction between a completed SIP close and a stale single-venue IEX observation. I did not inspect issuer or policy documents or perform valuation work.
main_conclusions: ANET had strong 21- and 63-session absolute momentum and led both SPY and XLK over those windows.
Near-term evidence is mixed: ANET led SPY but lagged XLK over five sessions, so absolute strength does not equal current sector leadership.
The close marginally exceeded the prior 21-session high while recent volume remained below its preceding median; the breakout evidence is therefore incomplete.
Observed path risk is high: 63-session realized volatility was about 50% annualized and the close path suffered a 15.5060% maximum drawdown.
Historical current-regime positive-return frequencies were lower than unconditional base rates at 5, 21, and 63 sessions, limiting probabilistic conviction.
agent_report.short_summary: Technically, ANET is an intact but extended medium-term uptrend with strong 21/63-session leadership and a 5-session sector-relative warning. Continuation needs persistence above trend support and renewed XLK-relative strength; loss of the frozen SMA20 plus sustained medium-window sector lag would materially weaken the setup.
limitations: Historical forward windows overlap and come from one finite ANET lookback, so frequencies are dependent and not calibrated forecasts.
Volume evidence is a small set of descriptive ratios, not intraday order flow or sustained-breakout confirmation.
The IEX snapshot is stale, single-venue, and non-executable; no current consolidated quote was available.
Corporate-action or event attribution within the 63-session path remained unconfirmed in this role.
